title: Cleaning the Car
hook: 一家人出门前先洗车，分工擦洗，结果用水管玩水，全家人和刚洗好的车又都脏了。

cells.q: Where is Daddy Pig taking the family?
cells.a: He is taking them for a drive in the country.
cells.cn: 他要带全家去乡下兜风。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say about the car?
cells.a: She said it is very messy inside the car.

cells.q: What must they do before the drive?
cells.a: They must clean the car before they go.
cells.cn: 出发前他们必须先把车洗干净。

cells.a: Daddy washes the roof, Mummy the bonnet, Peppa the doors.
cells.cn: 爸爸洗车顶，妈妈洗车头盖，佩奇洗车门。

cells.q: What did Peppa do with the muddy water?
cells.a: She threw the muddy water all over the car.
cells.cn: 她把泥水泼得满车都是。

cells.a: Because the garden hose splashed water on all of them.
cells.cn: 因为花园的水管把水喷到了每个人身上。

cells.q: What is Daddy Pig doing to the car?
cells.a: He is polishing it so well he can see his face.
cells.cn: 他把车擦得很亮，都能照见自己的脸。

cells.q: How does the car look now?
cells.a: It looks lovely and shiny after all their hard work.
cells.cn: 大家辛苦一阵，车子又亮又好看。

cells.a: She hoped they would all keep the car clean that day.
cells.cn: 她希望今天大家都能让车保持干净。

helper.keywords: car, messy, wash, roof, hose, shiny
helper.actions: clean, wash, throw, turn on, polish, keep

ending: In the end, the car is nice and shiny again. My favourite part is ______.
